This is a maraging-type stainless steel (Cr 10.5, Ni 10.3, Mo 3.1, Al 0.36, Ti 0.11), similar to a PH-type or Custom 465 alloy. I did not look up the dataset row, so this is an estimate and not the recorded value. Steels of this type usually have yield strengths of about 1500–2000 MPa. I chose a value in the middle of that range.
